With just weeks until its premiere, Apple TV released the trailer for the second season of "Women in Blue" today, please see below.

"Women in Blue" returns on August 12

Two years ago, almost at the same time, "Women in Blue" (Las Azules) premiered on Apple TV, airing 10 episodes.

This Spanish-language crime drama tells the story of "four women who challenge the extremely conservative social norms of the time and join Mexico's first female police force, only to discover that their squad is nothing more than a publicity stunt designed to distract the media from a brutal serial killer," Apple TV describes.

Adapted from a true story, "Women in Blue" was renewed for a second season in May 2025, with the premiere date recently announced: August 12.

Apple TV released the trailer for the second season today, with the company stating that the Azules will investigate a murder case related to the 1968 student massacre this season.
